presets.name: Gentle vocal
presets.description: Evens out a vocal without squashing it; ignores the lows below 100 Hz.

presets.name: Vocal leveler
presets.description: Holds a vocal firmly in place, quick to catch loud words.

presets.name: De-ess (sidechain bell)
presets.description: Listens to the sibilance around 6.5 kHz and turns the voice down on each 's'; set the frequency with Listen.

presets.name: Drum punch
presets.description: A slow attack lets each hit through, then the tail comes down: more punch.

presets.name: Kick tight
presets.description: Shortens a kick's boom and keeps its click.

presets.name: Snare snap
presets.description: Brings out the crack and controls the ring.

presets.name: Room crush
presets.description: Squashes room microphones hard, so the room breathes between the hits.

presets.name: Parallel smash
presets.description: Heavy compression blended under the dry sound: density without losing the hits.

presets.name: Bass control
presets.description: Keeps every note of a bass at the same level.

presets.name: Acoustic guitar
presets.description: Smooths strumming and keeps picking even.

presets.name: Piano smooth
presets.description: A gentle, slow hand on a piano's dynamics.

presets.name: Bus glue
presets.description: Holds a group together: slow attack, adaptive release, a couple of decibels down.

presets.name: Mix glue
presets.description: The lightest touch on the whole mix.

presets.name: Peak catcher
presets.description: Only the loudest peaks, fast; leaves the rest alone.

presets.name: Sidechain duck
presets.description: Choose a track under Sidechain (a kick): this one ducks each time it plays.
